title: Action in the second machine branch
statement: Let $N_0$ and $N_1$ be finite nondeterministic Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $a$ be a one-step action of $N_1$. The corresponding action on the combined machine has the same input-head movement and output; it leaves every work tape assigned to $N_0$ unchanged, uses $a$ on the work tapes assigned to $N_1$, and maps any successor state of $a$ into the second summand of the combined state type, with the outer option indicating a nonhalting state.
hypotheses_covered: Two finite nondeterministic Turing machines over Bool
